tools.name: diagnose_mcp_failure
tools.description: Diagnose sanitized MCP initialize, discovery, transport, capability and tool-schema failures. Returns bounded free checks and never performs a repair or payment.

tools.name: diagnose_api_auth_401
tools.description: Diagnose a sanitized HTTP 401 authentication failure without accepting credentials or contacting the target endpoint.

tools.name: diagnose_webhook_signature
tools.description: Diagnose a sanitized webhook signature/delivery failure without accepting the raw payload, signature value or signing secret.

tools.name: diagnose_json_schema_failure
tools.description: Diagnose a bounded JSON Schema or MCP input-schema type mismatch using only sanitized paths and types; no raw payload is required.
